A.task: Write an email of about 100 words to Alex, inviting him to a reading club. Explain why the club may interest him, describe its activities without inventing specific dates, and ask whether he would like to join. Sign Li Ming.
A.essay:
Dear Alex,

I has a reading club to recommend to you. We share books and discuss the ideas that interest us. I know you enjoy reading, so I think you would like the chance to exchange views with other readers.

The club is a friendly place to ask questions and learn from different experiences. You can introduce a book you enjoy or simply listen to what others have found. Please let me know whether you would like to join us.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours,
Li Ming
